rationale: Sustained high-borrow population (10 leveraged borrowers vs 5 steady LPs) to drive pool utilization toward the kink point. Classification flagged utilization_stress because the shared pool in state_mapping (pool.total_deposits / pool.total_borrows) implies a kink-point utilization curve where sustained borrow pressure interacts nonlinearly with the liquidation health-factor thresholds used by the steady-LP trigger.
